benefit.controlScope: Changes this project only. No global changes or plugin uninstall. Target:
benefit.controlBlockReason: Review individual entries by default. Disable the entire recommendation block if you do not need plugin discovery, avoiding candidate refill. Keep it if you still need recommendations. Installed plugins remain available; model-side installation suggestions are disabled.
benefit.controlBlockDisable: Disable all plugin recommendations in this project
benefit.controlBlockEnable: Enable plugin recommendations in this project
benefit.controlConfirmWarning: Project only. Check evidence and upcoming needs: unused does not mean unnecessary. Enabling an entry does not enable the block. Trusted project config and a new session are required. Verification covers config writes, not runtime token savings. Existing lists are merged; future parent-config changes need review.
benefit.controlUnchanged: Project configuration already has the requested state.
benefit.controlSuccess: Configuration written and verified. Start a new session to verify context; historical estimates are not actual savings. Operation ID:
benefit.controlRestored: Previous configuration restored. Start a new session. Operation ID:
benefit.controlUndoConfirm: Restore the project configuration before this operation? Subsequent edits will not be overwritten.
benefit.controlUsedReason: Reliable use exists in project history. Do not disable solely to reduce description tokens.
benefit.controlUnusedReason: No reliable use found in scanned history. Review for disable, but retain if needed by upcoming tasks, project instructions or retained workflows.
benefit.controlUnknownReason: History coverage or identity is insufficient. Absence of use cannot be established; retain by default.
benefit.controlUnsupported: Independent control is unverified. Review source and sibling Skill/tool dependencies; the whole plugin will not be disabled automatically.
benefit.controlAgentPrompt: Use skill-doctor-context-optimizer for project {{project}}. Audit skills_instructions and recommended_plugins using all readable Codex project history. Produce a complete report: coverage and gaps, baseline session with turn/response counts, per-item use evidence and keep/disable/uncertain reasons, control feasibility and dependencies, hypothetical token savings and cache attribution limits. Retain project dependencies, safety tools and uncertain entries. Default to individual project-local controls; explain whole-block recommendation control tradeoffs. Provide skill-doctor context control preview commands and exact targets/config paths. Wait for my confirmation before applying. Then report config verification, operation ID, undo command and new-session validation requirements. Do not uninstall plugins, change global config or contact MCP servers.
benefit.historyIntro: Project current catalog recommendations onto the longest main-session workload.
benefit.historyCatalogBasis: Based on injected entries, not installed inventory
benefit.historyBaselineRule: Most complete main-thread responses; newest activity breaks ties.
benefit.historyLimited: History is limited or incomplete; {{count}} incomplete files. Check evidence coverage.
benefit.historyDisclaimer: Hypothetical description-token savings, not realized savings. Cache attribution is estimated; hidden plugin candidates may refill removed suggestions.
benefit.historyNativeCounts: Native UserMessage items {{items}} · distinct turn IDs {{turns}} · completed turns {{completed}} (different measures)
benefit.historySourceTimes: Each catalog uses its latest complete record; timestamps may differ.
benefit.historyChild: Children excluded from main-session savings: {{count}} responses, input {{input}} / cached read {{cache}}.
benefit.historyCacheBounds: Deduct cached reads, then cache writes, then ordinary input. First-response cached-description bounds: {{lower}}–{{upper}} tokens. Request-level cache totals do not prove block-level hits.
benefit.historyWholeYes: The proposed set removes the entire block.
benefit.historyWholeNo: The proposed set filters individual suggestions, not the entire block.
benefit.historyControlWarning: Host runtime behavior is unverified. Whole-block removal also disables installation suggestions, not installed plugins. Unknown Skill controls require review; do not automatically disable their parent plugins or sibling skills.
